title: Pure Numeron
summary: Numeron cards with generic monster hand traps and staples. Numeron is a one-turn-kill engine that wants an empty field. Numeron Wall sends itself from the hand to activate Numeron Network from the Deck. Network then copies any Numeron Normal Spell straight from the Deck, and lets Numeron Xyz Monsters use effects without detaching. With no monsters, Numeron Calling summons all four Numeron Gate Xyz Monsters from the Extra Deck. Number 1: Numeron Gate Ekam becomes Number C1: Numeron Chaos Gate Sunya, which banishes every monster on the field. Sunya returns in your next Standby Phase and burns for the combined ATK of the banished Xyz Monsters. Numeron Chaos Ritual then summons Number C1000: Numerounius, and Numeron Storm follows up. Most Main Deck slots are hand traps, because the combo needs an empty field.
main: Starter: sends itself to activate Numeron Network from the Deck; ends the Battle Phase.
Field Spell: copies a Numeron Normal Spell from the Deck; Numeron Xyz effects without detaching.
Summons the four Numeron Gates from the Extra Deck.
Summons Number C1000: Numerounius with 10,000 ATK after Sunya falls.
Wipes their Spells/Traps and burns while you control Numerounius.
Ranks an Xyz into a Number C and negates every other face-up card.
extra: Rank 1: doubles Numeron ATK after battle; becomes Sunya.
